title: Grateful Dead Live at Orpheum Theatre on 1976-07-13
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC
source: (Front Row Balcony) Sony ECM-270 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-152SD) -> Dat

ai_review.summary: Clear‑instrument soundboard capture with a few glitches, and a great show that might even sound better as an audience recording.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as a fantastic performance, and the reviewer feels it could be the best version they’ve heard. The soundboard source offers excellent instrument separation but suffers from some problems, leading the fan to suggest an audience tape might actually be preferable.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review highlights a strong show and generally good soundboard clarity despite noted issues, resulting in a solid but not outstanding combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clarity between instruments is praised, but the reviewer notes unspecified problems with the soundboard that detract slightly from overall fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer describes the show as great overall with no specific complaints about pacing or song transitions.
